subject: On-prem/VPC option — post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finsky.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: On-prem/VPC option — post-call recap and next steps

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

Summary of needs we heard:
- Production inference for financial document processing (PII redaction + embeddings for search).
- Hard requirement for data residency in US East and a private network boundary (VPC / on-prem overlay).
- Latency target: p95 < 200ms for real-time tagging; throughput: ~50 reqs/s peak.
- Security: SOC 2 + customer-managed KMS and audit logs are must-haves.

What we suggested on the call:
- Redwood Private (VPC) deployment with optional on-prem package for air-gapped ingestion.
- Dedicated capacity to guarantee throughput + autoscale policies for batch runs.

Recommended next steps:
1) Confirm priority and target timeline (you mentioned "early Q1" as a target).
2) Share procurement contact and platform/network admin for technical alignment.
3) I can put together a short SOW + network requirements spreadsheet to kick off procurement.

I attached a one-page network_requirements.xlsx (stub) to highlight firewall rules and proxy expectations — happy to iterate. If this is higher priority than you indicated, tell me and I’ll accelerate a draft SOW and a canary rollout plan.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: network_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 4 rows)
